RE: Draft Environmental
Statement, Executive
Order 11644, Concerning
the use of Motorized
Off-Road Vehicles
Dear Mr. Wellborn:
We have reviewed the above captioned statement and offer the following comments:
a. (Page 6) Under the operating criteria subsection, permits may be issued for the operation of Off-Road Vehicles on areas designated for their use for organized races. Criteria for the selection of these areas should carefully weigh the resulting environmental disturbances to the area. Also relating to this subsection, the operation of motorized vehicles (especially motorcycles and minibikes) by persons under legal licensing age will be difficult to control.
b. (Page 12) The second paragraph on this page states that ORV's provide safe and convenient transportation to portions of the public lands not otherwise accessible to the benefit of society. The inaccessibility of many public lands is the very factor that attracts many people to these areas. Cheapening the quality of a person's visit by making all areas easily accessible (along with the resultant environmental disturbances inherent to ORV's) will accelerate the already rapidly diminishing areas suitable for a quality natural experience.
c. (Page 14) ORV use in camping and picnicking areas will tend to push wildlife in these areas into more remote sections. The loss of these animals will detract from the quality of a recreational visit.
d. (Page 16) In the long run, ORV use will result in more forest fires being started than it will aid in the prevention of these fires.
